column1: # net4sats/installer — PIN MANIFEST (DATA, not code)
# Every upstream ref this repository builds from, and the exact commit each one
# must be. This file is DATA: it is the one place the pinned ref NAMES may
# appear, and the build script READS them from here instead of spelling them.
# scripts/build-pinned-upstream.sh refuses to build if any recorded commit
# disagrees with the remote.
# WHY TAGS AND NOT BRANCHES
#   The upstream PRs behind these pins are open and deliberately NOT merged
#   (operator release freeze: pre-releases are with the review club; merging
#   waits for a release and a clean slate). Those PR BRANCHES are the review
#   vehicle and may be REBASED when the release lands. These TAGS are the
#   dependency and do not move. That separation is the whole point: a rebase of
#   pr/... cannot silently change what this repository builds.
# DO NOT FORCE-PUSH, DELETE OR RE-POINT ONE OF THESE TAGS
#   Moving a pin is a deliberate act. Cut a NEW tag (…-2) and record it here, so
#   an existing build stays reproducible. See docs/PINS.md.
# COLUMNS:  <commit>  <repo>  <tag>  <role>
#   role=base    the newest-base installer pin; composed FIRST
#   role=cherry  an independent installer pin; cherry-picked onto base
#   role=module  a different repository; recorded, never cherry-picked here
# Independence is asserted by the build script in BOTH directions with
# `git merge-base --is-ancestor` — these pins are mutually independent and do
# NOT share a base (comfast descends from 5df4c9c; the other two from 346e473).
